messages:
Alex W: Quick update — ran a small-batch microcanary for Chimera-10B (int6) against our longform product slice (500 sessions). Results are a bit mixed: latency tail is fine, but unit token cost is ~1.6x baseline Mistral-lite across the same prompt mix. Quality delta: +0.8% exact-match on narrow QA, but a 1.2% drop on multi-turn coherence signals. Full numbers below.

Marta P: can you paste the perf and cost breakdown? curious about KV cache hit behavior and batch sizes used.

Alex W: sure — here's the run command and summary:
```
./run_microcanary --model chimera-10b-int6 --samples 500 --batch 8 --kv-cache true --quant q6
```
Summary: median latency 210ms (baseline 200ms), p95 680ms (baseline 720ms), tokens per request avg 320, cost per 1k tokens $0.78 vs baseline $0.49. EM(QA) +0.8, CoherenceScore -1.2. KV cache hit ~42% (lower than expected because prompts include randomized system preamble).

Jia L: 1.6x cost is large — is that mostly due to model flop or lower batching efficiency? any GPU util numbers?

Alex W: GPU util was ~62% vs baseline 58% (so slightly better), but memory layout for int6 quant path increased kernel overhead on our runtime (extra memcpy for packing). The main cost driver is slower per-token kernel time, not throughput.

Sam R: Could we try increasing batch to 12 for the canary to see if unit price drops at slight latency tradeoff? Also what's the sample-level breakdown — which slices lost coherence?

Alex W: Good idea. Slice breakdown: multi-turn summarization and persona chat show coherence drop. Single-turn factual QA and short completions improved slightly. I can re-run with batch=12 and batch=16.

Marta P: From product/GTN POV we prefer improved QA but not sacrificing chat coherence. Proposal: holdback 20% of traffic to chimera-int6 deployed behind a signal flag that routes single-turn QA and search queries, keep multi-turn chat on baseline. If signal passes after 2k sessions, expand.

Jia L: Agree. Also add an automated eval hook to compare LMScore (coherence metric) on rolling window and trigger rollback if delta < -0.8. We had regressions slip before.

ops-bot: Deployment created: chimera-10b-int6-canary (holdback=20%, routes=qa,search). Canary ID: dep-2026-03-330999.

Sam R: Can we add a cost override to route non-urgent low-priority traffic to a cheaper int8 variant if cost > 1.4x baseline? Might protect unit economics while we tune.

Alex W: I'll spin an int8 candidate (chimera-10b-int8-lite) for A/B. Next steps: 1) re-run microcanary with batch 12/16 and report updated unit cost + latency numbers; 2) attach coherence and QA eval hooks; 3) deploy holdback 20% with routing rules (qa/search only) and cost guardrail -> revert if unit cost > 1.4x after 24h.

Marta P: sounds good. Please post the re-run numbers in this thread. If the coherence regression persists we should pause rollout.

Alex W: Will do. Starting batch=12 run now. ETA ~45m.

Jia L: thanks — also add a short sample of failed coherence cases to the ticket so PD/product can triage examples.

Alex W: noted. Adding sample artifacts to the canary dep and will link back here. :thumbsup:
